_note: TemplateManifestSchema (packages/spec/src/marketplace/template-manifest.zod.ts) — `objectstack.manifest.json`, the package-listing file an author writes beside objectstack.config.ts. Read by `os package publish` (packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts) and by create-objectstack at scaffold; parsed for every shipped file by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:template-manifests`; never loaded by a runtime boot. GOVERNED VIA THE GATE'S SPEC-ONLY OVERRIDE (SPEC_ONLY_SCHEMAS), seeded 2026-11-06 with the marketplace taxonomy, whose facet keys (`businessFunctions`, `industries`, `solutionType`, `maturity`) have their consumers in the cloud catalog (objectstack-ai/cloud#3661) and the console — a row is where those consumers are named. MEASUREMENT: every row below was measured for this seeding against objectstack origin/main 7d9682ffd7 plus the taxonomy change, and the cloud leg against cloud origin/main 8f574b9 (its publish route reads `tags` and the category it retires; it drops every facet key today). The `dead` rows other than `category` are what entering the denominator found, not part of the taxonomy: they are recorded here, not retired.

manifestId.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts#PackagePublish (`--manifest-id ?? m.manifestId ?? deriveManifestId(...)` — the package id the publish request is addressed by)
manifestId.note: Optional on this file by design (the derived `local.<slug>` covers a tree that declares none); a declared value wins over the derived one.

displayName.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts#PackagePublish (`flags['display-name'] ?? m.displayName ?? deriveDisplayName(...)` → `display_name` on the package request)

description.note: create-objectstack drops the template's own description at scaffold, so a scaffolded project carries none until its author writes one.

visibility.note: Read only to be named in a warning: `uncarriedManifestWarnings` (packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts) tells the author that `os package publish` does not read `visibility` from this file and that `--visibility` carries it. The value an author writes here changes nothing. Recorded on the taxonomy enrolment (the first time this file was in the denominator); not retired here.

category.note: REMOVED 2026-11-06 — tombstoned at the schema (retiredKey carries the prescription; authoring it is a tsc error and a parse error), refused by name by `os package publish` (`retiredCategoryRefusal`) and by `check:template-manifests` for every shipped file. No D2 conversion: this file is not a stack collection member (D3 `marketplace-category-retired`). The entry stays because retiredKey keeps the key in the walked shape; declare `businessFunctions`, `industries` and `solutionType` instead.

businessFunctions.note: 1-3 business functions, the primary first; required to submit to the marketplace (the cloud submit policy, cloud#3661). CONSUMERS (named per the marketplace-taxonomy ruling): the cloud catalog stores and filters it — objectstack-ai/cloud#3661, not landed at cloud origin/main 8f574b9, whose publish route picks named body keys and drops this one today — and the console marketplace (`ui/`), whose facet filters, badges and labels are the console card the repo:cloud#3 seat files from the taxonomy PR. IN THIS REPO: `os package publish` judges the value with the spec's own schema and forwards it under its wire name (`readPublishTaxonomy`), so a malformed value is refused before any network call — a gate, not a consumer. Flip to `live` with a cloud-attributed pointer when cloud#3661 lands.

solutionType.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts#readPublishTaxonomy (a declared `template` or `connector` is checked against the built artifact by `explainSolutionTypeContradiction` — a `template` whose artifact permits no `unmanaged` install, or a `connector` that declares no connector, is refused before any network call — then sent as `solution_type`)
solutionType.note: Live in this repo through the publish cross-check: authoring the key changes what publish accepts. Its catalog half — storing it, filtering by it, the `my_apps` view — is objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 (not landed at cloud 8f574b9, which drops the key today), and its console half (a type tab or segment) is the console card the repo:cloud#3 seat files.

tags.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts#PackagePublish (`if (m.tags !== undefined) pkgBody.tags = m.tags` — sent as written; the hosted route owns the bounds)
tags.note: Search only: tags generate no filter. The cloud catalog validates and stores them (cloud @8f574b9: packages/service-cloud/src/routes/package-publish.ts#readPublishTags).

publisher.note: Decided by the platform: `os package publish` names it in a warning (`uncarriedManifestWarnings`, PLATFORM_DECIDED_MANIFEST_KEYS) and never sends it — the hosted control plane assigns the trust tier from the caller's credentials. An author's value has no effect. Recorded on the taxonomy enrolment; not retired here.

isStarter.note: Decided by the platform: `os package publish` names it in a warning and never sends it; the hosted control plane honours a starter flag only on a first-party service-mode seed (cloud @8f574b9 package-publish.ts, `isFirstPartySeed`). The bundled blank template still ships `isStarter: true`, which is why the warning does not fail the publish. Recorded on the taxonomy enrolment; not retired here.
